findings.claim: lab.json claims configuration-files-and-profiles#o1 ('Read settings from application.properties or application.yaml into a @ConfigurationProperties record and with @Value'). The CatalogProperties record ships complete, the learner only adds property lines (Tasks 3-5), and @Value appears nowhere in the lab, so the record-authoring and @Value parts of the claimed objective are observed rather than practiced.
findings.recommendation: Have the learner add the pageSize component to the CatalogProperties record themselves (one line, keeps the 30-minute budget), or scope the claim down in the lab's objectives/evidence.

findings.claim: The class comment says 'pageSize is an Integer so the application still starts while Task 2 has not set it yet', but setting catalog.page-size is Task 3 in the README (Task 2 is the detail route). A learner cross-referencing task numbers from the file they are told to read will be briefly misdirected.
findings.recommendation: Change 'Task 2' to 'Task 3' in the comment (note: this byte change stales the lab's solved-run binding and requires a private reproof).
